::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Arm's India centre contributes to the design of Cortex CPU and Mali/Immortalis GPU IP that powers billions of devices globally.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Cortex-A/R/M CPU IP cores, Mali and Immortalis GPU IP, system IP (interconnects, memory controllers), and physical IP for advanced nodes.
